title: Getting comfortable with the uncomfortable
html:
Too often we put things off that we find hard to do; phone calls, accounts, things where you might get a “no” from someone, and do the “fun” things instead. In the end, we have to do these things and when we do the weight off our shoulders is HUGE.

You often think, why didn't I do this sooner. It wasn't that hard. I got a yes!

Procrastination is JUST AN EXCUSE. Yup, you heard me. Just. An. Excuse. This is a reminder for me too 🙂

So this week, pick some things you have been putting off, take action and do them.

Watch for the result, it may surprise you.

You're awesome! Tell yourself enough times that you believe it too.

My best to you.

Glenn Edley

P.S. You might have heard the maxim that how you do anything is how you do everything. I believe that and struggle with it every day. But I think it’s an effective way to think about what you’re doing at any time. Jesse Itzler explains it well in this short video. Watch here ›
